normative_extracts.quote: Animation frame callbacks are invoked during the update the rendering step of the event loop, receiving a high-resolution DOMHighResTimeStamp.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Compositor ticks on display VSync (60Hz/120Hz), triggers BeginMainFrame, drains rAF callbacks, and commits the frame.

production_failures.symptom: Animation runs twice as fast on 120Hz ProMotion displays compared to 60Hz monitors
production_failures.root_cause: Advancing position by a fixed step per rAF tick instead of multiplying by delta-time (timestamp - lastTimestamp).
production_failures.mitigation: Always compute animation progress from the DOMHighResTimeStamp argument passed to the rAF callback.

production_failures.root_cause: Long macrotasks or synchronous layout reads inside the rAF callback exceed the 16.6ms (or 8.3ms) VSync budget.
production_failures.mitigation: Batch DOM reads before writes, keep rAF work under 4ms, or offload animations to CSS/WAAPI.
